newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Max defers rights issue, may buy business.
newsitem.headline: Max defers rights issue, may buy business.

text.p: Max Resources on Friday said it was continuing its discussions in relation to the possible acquisition of an industrial business managed from Western Australia.
It also said it had deferred indefinitely its non-renounceable rights issue.
"This potential major transaction will, subject to due diligence and Max Resources shareholder approval, result in a change of direction for the company," Max said in a statement.

"Also we advise that formal advice has been received that Max is due for a further payment of A$100,000 from its Norseman gold project joint venture partners. This amount will be received by November 30, 1996.

"In view of the above the board has resolved to defer indefinitely the recently approved non-renounceable rights issue. If Max does proceed with the proposed major transaction then this rights issue will be cancelled."
